text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"Passez un merveilleux moment.
Please, enjoy yourself. ...Thank you for your cooperation."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Yayoi. I hear they managed to boot up
the VR Umalator over there as well.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"A relief!
Now then, let us head to the press conference as well!"

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Yeah. It's the first "L'Arc Representative Exchange Match" of the year.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Let's launch a massive firework
worthy of kicking off the festival.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: —Venus Park is entering the race?!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Following last year, as I take on the challenge of the
"Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe," I judged that gaining race experience against her was essential.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Wait, wait... Venus Park...
Are you sure she's the girl who was France's favorite to win the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"She's the French Umamusume of the Year, you know?!
And next month, she was supposed to be entered in a GⅠ on par with the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe...!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text: When they need to focus like that, taking a match against a Japanese Umamusume is a card their camp would never... ever play...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
Precisely because it seemed like a dream, I made it a reality!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: There was a time when even the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, which we strive for, was deemed an impossible pipe dream.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Yet if we keep challenging ourselves, change will come.
We can forge a brand-new era.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Just as we managed to secure such a promise this time.
Just as the world dreamed of them last year.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Why not chase after romance—a little more?

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text: "...Magnificent. It's just like the scenery of Longchamp... So this is VR...!"

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
! Bonjour!
I remember you guys!

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text: "You were at the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, weren't you?"
choice_data_list: Yeah, I competed against you at the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.
Yeah, competed against you in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
Je vois.
So that's why Master and Mei...

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Let's make today's race
something truly extraordinary together!

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
"And maybe I could 'lend a hand' as well?
...Go ahead?"
